storyCards.headline: Hit Me With Your Best Shot: The Performance That Defined It
storyCards.fact:
Pat Benatar's "Hit Me With Your Best Shot" reached #9 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #9 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.

Hit Me With Your Best Shot was released in 1989.
